data.narrative:
Overland AI is a Series A defense and security company founded by Byron Boots, Greg Okopal, and Stephanie Bonk, with $40M+ in total raised. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies (2 public, 8 private) in the Defense & Security sector at equivalent stages, including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $40M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying $80M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range of $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), reflecting substantial dispersion in this subsector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $68M to $460M, with a median of $240M across both methods. This wide spread reflects the heterogeneity within defense-tech valuations at this stage. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to peer benchmarks, customer concentration among defense buyers, and technical differentiation in autonomous systems and AI capabilities. The peer range itself ($125M–$4.0B) underscores how stage-equivalent companies in this sector command dramatically different valuations based on deployment scale and strategic positioning.
